product_metadata.title: amscan Marvel Avengers Powers Unite Hanging Swirl Decorations - Assorted Designs, 12 Pcs
features: PACKAGE INCLUDES: 12 hanging swirls - assorted sizes
VIBRANT DESIGN: Complete your party with these hanging swirls that feature attached image of Avengers characters.
GREAT DECORATION: These hanging swirls are a great decoration for your child's Avengers-themed party.
QUALITY MATERIAL: Made from non-toxic, high-quality thick paper cards, which can be used for a long time.
EASY TO USE: These hanging swirls can be used to hang from the ceiling, wall, tree, curtain, or door.
description: Transform your home and complete the decoration with these Avengers Hanging swirls. Package contains 12 pcs. Avengers hanging swirl decorations which has 5" paper cutouts atttached. These cardstock hanging swirls are black, blue, green, red, and yellow with attached cardstock cutouts images of favorite Avengers: Captain Marvel, Black Panther, Captain America, Iron Man, and Hulk. Perfect for everybody's birthday celebration, hang these decorations from the ceiling or in a doorway making the venue more fun and alive.
